about: The open-source iOS apps the compile sweep builds against SwiftUIWeb (Tools/Coverage/README.md). Chosen from dkhamsing/open-source-ios-apps (tag swiftui, updated since mid 2024, iOS apps; Kotlin Multiplatform, watch-, tv-, vision- and Mac-only apps and libraries left out), plus Apple's two published SwiftUI samples and two of the apps of decision 0021 as controls. `ref` pins a commit; an app without one is built at its default branch's head and the report records the commit it got.
